name: Release Key and Role Separation
description: TUF-style role separation: root, targets, snapshot, timestamp. No single key can compromise the update system.
purpose: Prevent any single key compromise from allowing an attacker to sign malicious updates by separating signing authority into TUF roles with independent keys and limited trust.
acceptanceCriteria: TUF role separation is implemented: root, targets, snapshot, and timestamp roles.
Each role has a dedicated key (or set of threshold keys).
Root key is offline and used only for root metadata rotation.
Targets keys sign target metadata (file hashes and locations).
Snapshot keys sign the snapshot metadata (version of all targets metadata).
Timestamp keys sign the timestamp metadata (latest snapshot version).
No single key can sign for more than one role.
Key rotation procedure is documented and tested.
Threshold signing is supported for root and targets roles.
